title: Pure Herald
summary: The Herald Fairy Ritual build with Pre-Preparation of Rites and generic staples. Every small Herald monster acts as a hand trap that discards another Fairy to negate an opponent's card, and as Fairy fuel in hand for Herald of Ultimateness and Herald of Perfection.

summary.title: Starters
points: Diviner of the Herald sends any Fairy from the Deck to the GY on Normal or Special Summon to increase its Level by that monster's Level, and Special Summons a Level 2 or lower Fairy from the hand or Deck when Tributed.
Pre-Preparation of Rites adds Dawn of the Herald + Herald of Perfection, or Oracle of the Herald + Herald of Ultimateness, directly from your Deck to your hand.

summary.title: Opening: Diviner of the Herald + Oracle of the Herald + Herald of Ultimateness
steps: Normal Summon Diviner of the Herald and send a spare copy of Herald of Ultimateness (Level 12) from the Deck to the GY so Diviner becomes Level 14.
Activate Oracle of the Herald, Tributing the Level 14 Diviner of the Herald to Ritual Summon Herald of Ultimateness from your hand without your opponent being able to respond.

Diviner of the Herald's Tribute trigger Special Summons Herald of Orange Light, Herald of Green Light, or Herald of Purple Light from the Deck, or two Level 2 Fairies can overlay into Herald of Pure Light to add the sent Fairy back from the GY to your hand for negation fuel.

summary.title: Control & Hand Traps
points: Herald of Ultimateness sends 1 Fairy from the hand to the GY to negate any Spell, Trap, or monster effect activation, or any Special Summon, and destroy it.
Herald of Perfection sends 1 Fairy from the hand to the GY to negate any Spell, Trap, or monster effect activation.
From the hand, Herald of Orange Light discards itself and another Fairy to negate a monster effect, Herald of Green Light negates a Spell, and Herald of Purple Light negates a Trap.

Herald of Mirage Lights negates a Spell/Trap by sending a Fairy from the hand to the GY and recovers 2 Ritual Monsters or Ritual Spells when destroyed, while Herald of Pure Light and Herald of Creation recycle Fairies and Ultimateness from the GY.

summary.title: Spells
points: Oracle of the Herald Ritual Summons Herald of Ultimateness and prevents either player from activating cards or effects in response to its activation.
Dawn of the Herald Ritual Summons Herald of Perfection using exact Levels, then banishes itself from the GY to return one of the Tributed monsters from the GY to the hand.
Herald of the Abyss pays 1500 LP to force the opponent to send a face-up monster of a declared Type and Attribute to the GY.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: Herald of the Arc Light is Forbidden in the TCG, and the page's Drytron and Cyber Angel engines are omitted in this pure build. Heraldic Beast and Heraldry cards belong to a separate archetype.

main: Diviner of the Herald
Starter Tuner: sends a Fairy to raise its Level; tributed, summons a Level 2 Fairy from the Deck.
Herald of Ultimateness
Level 12 Ritual: discards a Fairy to negate a summon or any activation; Diviner sends a spare.
Herald of Perfection
Level 6 Ritual: discards a Fairy to negate an activation.
Herald of Orange Light
Hand trap with another Fairy: negates a monster effect; Level 2 Tuner.
Herald of Green Light
Hand trap with another Fairy: negates a Spell.
Herald of Purple Light
Hand trap with another Fairy: negates a Trap.
Herald of Creation
Discards to return Herald of Ultimateness from the GY to the hand.
Oracle of the Herald
Ritual Spell for Ultimateness; they can't respond to it.
Dawn of the Herald
Ritual Spell for Perfection; returns a Tribute to the hand.
Pre-Preparation of Rites
Generic: searches a Ritual Spell and the Herald it names.
Herald of the Abyss
Forces them to send a monster of a declared Type and Attribute.
extra: Link-2 from two LIGHT Fairies: negates a Spell/Trap; recovers Rituals when destroyed.
Rank 2: returns a monster from the GY to the hand.
Link-2: Quick Effect Link Summons during opponent's Main Phase and gives the summoned monster effect-destruction immunity.
